app_info.subtitle: Your GSC SEO Copilot

test_cases.description: Discover the sites available in the current authorized connection.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns only authorized sites with safe identifying details and no credentials or internal identifiers.

test_cases.description: Review current Search Console performance for a confirmed site.
test_cases.user_prompt: How many clicks, impressions, and what CTR did my site get in the last 28 days?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the selected site, reporting dates, metrics, and a concise evidence-based insight.

test_cases.description: Open the visual dashboard after site selection is confirmed.
test_cases.user_prompt: Open my TrustSEO dashboard for the selected site.
test_cases.expected_output: Opens the dashboard for the confirmed authorized site without CSP or asset errors.

test_cases.description: Analyze ranking quality for an authorized URL.
test_cases.user_prompt: Analyze the SERP quality for a URL on my selected site.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns GSC-derived visibility, ranking, CTR, findings, and recommendations without inventing live SERP data.

test_cases.description: Inspect existing structured data for an authorized URL.
test_cases.user_prompt: What structured data does the selected site's pricing page have?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns parsed JSON-LD objects from the authorized page, or an empty schema list when none is present.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke TrustSEO for unrelated calendar work.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What meetings do I have tomorrow?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because calendar management is outside TrustSEO's supported workflows.

negative_test_cases.description: Reject a site that is outside the authenticated selected-site scope.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Analyze this property that is not connected to my TrustSEO account.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app declines or asks the user to connect and confirm a TrustSEO site; it does not fetch an unauthorized property.

negative_test_cases.description: Ask for clarification instead of guessing among similarly named sites.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Compare performance for my site when I have multiple connected sites with similar names.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app asks the user to identify the intended authorized site before running a comparison.
